#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> a[i];

    vector<int> costs;
    int odd = 0, even = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (a[i] % 2 == 0) even++;
        else odd++;
        if (odd == even) {
            costs.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i+1]));
        }
    }
    sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());
    int spent = 0, cuts = 0;
    for (int cost : costs) {
        if (spent + cost <= b) {
            spent += cost;
            cuts++;
        } else break;
    }
    cout << cuts << endl;
    return 0;
}
